title: Product Claim Fragment
description: One MLR-reviewable promotional claim about Tarnexa (quilvecitinib), reusable across HCP web, rep email, MSL/agent assist and chat. A claim is a statement plus the references that substantiate it plus the safety context it must travel with. Field-level `x-review` tiers drive the diff classifier; `x-channel` lists where a field may render.

reviewTier.description: Minimum review tier for a change to this field. The classifier may RAISE a fragment's tier above the max of its changed fields; it may never lower below it.

refId.description: Reference id from brand/references.md (the approved reference library).

loading.description: Q-matrix loading: does this attribute drive engagement with this fragment? 0 = no, 1 = yes. Fractional values reserved for calibrated discrimination later.

id.description: Stable fragment identifier; also the filename. Never changes after first merge.

author.description: IMS user ID of the human author (1:1 passthrough for the PoC; pseudonymize here later). Stored ONLY in this field, never in commit metadata.

templateId.description: Constrained template used, if any. Template-bound sources earn reputation faster.

effectiveFrom.description: Earliest date this content may be published. Approval and release are separate decisions.

scope.description: What the claim is allowed to be about. Changing scope changes what the references must support.

indication.const: Moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis in adults

population.description: Sub-population the claim is scoped to. TNF-IR is the labeled population.

comparator.description: If a comparison is made, what against. Named marketed competitors are forbidden (see glossary).

headline.description: Attention line. Not itself a claim; must not state a result.

lede.description: Plain-language framing. May paraphrase claimText; may not add results.

claimText.description: The substantiated statement, verbatim as approved. Every number in it must appear in a cited reference.

referenceIds.description: References that substantiate claimText. Lint fails on unknown ids and on an efficacy claim with no pivotal-trial reference.

dataPoints.description: Structured copy of each figure in claimText so the classifier can diff numbers, not prose.

safetyStatementId.description: Id of the required safety statement from brand/glossary.md that must travel with this claim type.

fairBalanceText.description: Channel-specific fair balance copy when the full ISI cannot render (email, chat). Verbatim from glossary.

mslTalkingPoints.description: Guidance for MSLs / inside reps. Not HCP-facing.

kolQuote.description: Attributed expert quote. Fictional KOL for the demo.

attributes.description: Q-matrix row for Audience of One. Which latent HCP attributes drive engagement with this fragment. Registry: models/attributes.json.

evidenceDepth.description: Rung on the evidence ladder this fragment represents (polytomous item). 1 summary · 2 pivotal · 3 subgroup/TNF-IR · 4 safety tables · 5 real-world · 6 MSL request.

dataStatus.description: Every figure in this repo is invented for a demo. This field makes that machine-checkable.

mlrJobId.description: Downstream MLR system id once approved (roadmap).

allOf.$comment: Efficacy and safety claims must carry structured data points so numbers are diffed as numbers.
Anything that renders in email or chat must carry fair-balance text, since the full ISI cannot.
